WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.675993 45.522611)',4326) AS pt
),
nearby_tiles AS (
  SELECT d.rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, origin o
  WHERE d.rast && ST_Expand(o.pt, 1.0)
),
masked AS (
	  SELECT ST_MapAlgebra(
	           rast,
	           1,
	           '32BF'::text,
	           'CASE WHEN [rast.val] > 1800 THEN [rast.val] ELSE NULL END'::text,
	           NULL::double precision
	         ) AS rast
  FROM nearby_tiles
),
qualifying_pixels AS (
  SELECT (pp).geom AS geom
  FROM masked
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL ST_PixelAsCentroids(rast, 1, TRUE) AS pp
)
SELECT MIN(ST_Distance(p.geom::geography, o.pt::geography)) AS distance_m
FROM qualifying_pixels p, origin o;

  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-122.675993, 45.522611), 4326))
),
elevation_raster_clipped AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(high_elevation_areas.rast, true, ST_Buffer(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-122.675993, 45.522611), 4326), 100000)) AS rast
  FROM high_elevation_areas
),
elevation_points AS (
  SELECT (ST_PixelAsPoints(rast, 1)).*
  FROM elevation_raster_clipped
),
filtered_elevation_points AS (
  SELECT geom
  FROM elevation_points
  WHERE value > 1800
),
closest_point AS (
  SELECT MIN(ST_Distance(poi_location.geom, filtered_elevation_points.geom)) AS distance_meters
  FROM poi_location, filtered_elevation_points
)
SELECT closest_point.distance_meters;
